no audio request or context before activation; keyboard starts actual analysed playback
pause damps to the exact straight pair, stops work and resumes the real media position
the complete real excerpt ends naturally and REPLAY starts from the beginning
reverse/offscreen pauses, becomes idle work and never resumes without another gesture
rapid toggles and media seeks do not leave duplicate graphs or false playback
MENU/Esc restores focus; counterpart navigation releases media and context
reduced motion keeps ordered narrative and real listening with static lines
live reduced preference preserves truthful playback through static-layout reflow
320px enlarged text has readable controls and no horizontal trap
unavailable source is disabled and truthful, with no fake clock
media failure is announced and retry never invents playback
cancel while loading remains paused after delayed bytes arrive
missing Web Audio capability keeps real playback with an explicit static visual
direct anchor and rapid reverse preserve the single line pair without starting audio
a technically present but unapproved source cannot activate media
hidden-document event pauses and suspends; visibility return never autoplays
failed instrument imagery preserves static narrative followed by usable SOUND
a stalled source times out truthfully and leaves no background analysis
resizing active playback to mobile settles every old desktop sample on pause
replay reuses buffered media and its single graph instead of issuing another load
line friction rejects DC drift, retains current points and damps after interruption
320px KO and EN captions and all listening states have distinct readable space
eight route returns release every previous context and do not accumulate Sound DOM
